data.name: Safety Force
data.detailed_description:
WORK TOGETHER. PROTECT HOME-FRONT.

Join a ragtag emergency response force and deploy into dangerous missions across a world shaped by militarism, industrial decay, and escalating disasters. Team up with up to 6 players online, choose from 6 unique classes, and fight your way through hostile environments where every mission can quickly spiral out of control.

Whether you're rescuing trapped civilians, defending critical objectives, or battling overwhelming enemy forces, success depends on teamwork, adaptability, and making the most of your squad's strengths.

SIX CLASSES, COUNTLESS LOADOUTS

Choose from six distinct classes, each with their own abilities, equipment, and playstyles. Customize your gear, specialize your role, and build a team capable of handling any situation.

VEHICLES AND HEAVY EQUIPMENT

Take control of a variety of vehicles to transport your team, move supplies, reach objectives, or carve a path through enemy territory.

A WORLD ON THE BRINK

Explore environments inspired by military infrastructure, industrial facilities, rural communities, and disaster-stricken regions. Beneath the uniforms and machinery lies a world struggling to hold itself together.

FEATURES

  • Online co-op for 1–6 players

  • 6 playable classes with unique abilities

  • Extensive character and loadout customization

  • Drivable vehicles and mission equipment

  • Objective-based missions and replayable operations

  • A stylized world inspired by military and emergency response themes

The situation is deteriorating. Gear up, assemble your squad, and get to work.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit version 1909 revision 1350 or higher, or versions 2004 and 20H2 revision 789 or higher
  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 11 or 12 compatible graphics card
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: N/A
  • VR Support: N/A
